plain_summary: This page details various fees related to late orders, cancellations, and late/incomplete submission of cargo documentation. It lists specific charges for cargo dues order amendments, late manifests/outturn reports, and cargo dues order framing. Additionally, it specifies fees for cargo conveyed by vessels permitted to service other vessels within and outside the port, and administrative fees for photocopies.

calculation_relevant_numbers.context: Cargo dues order amendment fee per order
Late, incomplete and non-submission of manifests and outturn reports per manifest/outturn report
Cargo dues order framing fee per order
Cargo conveyed by vessel permitted to service vessels within and outside the port, per trip
Administrative fees for photocopies per page
